title: Dungeon Battle Royale
titleRomaji: Dungeon Battle Royale: Maou ni Natta node Sekai Touitsu wo Mezashimasu
titleNative: ダンジョンバトルロワイヤル 〜魔王になったので世界統一を目指します〜
synonyms: Dungeon Battle Royale ~ Since I Became a Demon King, I Will Aim for World Domination ~
synopsis: One day everyone on earth suddenly receives a mysterious survey email. The mail states that the world salvation project has begun and that everyone will be divided into LAW, CHAOS and NEUTRAL. Shion Kurosaki, a loner freshman in university, was sorted into CHAOS. Which means that in the new world he is to be a Demon Lord who needs to prepare his dungeon, fill it with monsters and fend off the attacks from the LAW heroes. A dungeon building adventure begins! (Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Niragi Kioumaru
synopsis: Since his childhood, Kiomaru has been formed by master Sadamitsu of the Gassan forge so that he could later become a specialist in sword making. One day, when he learns of the brutal death of a young man to which he sold his first sword, he realize his own inexperience and decides to adopt a new attitude by following an exacting training. After avenging the young man, he continues his training, but one day, his master reveal to him an unbelievable secret: 18 years ago, meteorites nicknamed "Steel of the stars" fell from the sky on a dark mountain. Since that day, it seems the wheel of destiny enforced itself.

title: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See
titleNative: 魔術師クノンは見えている
synonyms: Kunon The Sorcerer Can See Through

synopsis: Kunon Gurion, who was born blind, has one goal in life: finding a way to use his magic to see, something no one has ever done before. Luckily, Kunon's talent for magic leads him to quickly surpass his teacher. Before long, his name reaches even the royal palace, earning him the rare opportunity to study under a powerful mentor. (Source: Yen Press)

synopsis: Believing himself to be useless at football, Aizawa Kakeru opts to become the manager of his school's football team, while his brother Suguru is its ace, and is even good enough to represent Japan. However, Kakeru may be harbouring a strong talent within himself that only Suguru can see, and the two often get into arguments over Kakeru's denial of his skills. Things are made more complicated with the return of Nana, an old playmate of theirs that Kakeru has a crush on. Join the brothers in their journey to the national and even international championships! Story written under the penname Igano, Hiroaki.
